text: I love this game! I love it so much. the problem is it never misses a chance to shove an offer for me to pay them money in my face. If I was interested, I would have taken the offer the first time. now, every time I run out of rolls or enter the game, I gotta close 5 offers. every. single. time. would be 5 stars but I hate pushy advertising. enough that it only gets 2.

Super cute and really fun game. Addicting but quickly losing interest Rewards are too small and too far between. It takes thousands upon thousands of rolls to rank in tournaments. Trails are tough to complete without buying steps or rolls. Completing tasks and challenges, such as growing a pet by feeding it, is next to impossible without spending a lot of money. Many people have voiced this on the FB page but developers aren't listening. Also, pricing for packages is not equal for all players

This the game is a lot more fun than I thought rolling a couple of dice could ever be. The graphics are really fun to watch the animations of the characters that are just silly & funny. The game is actually pretty exciting because you get to steal $$$ from other people, attack another player's building for $$$, and you never really know what your three dice are going to land on. I've played a couple of other games from this company and I really liked what they make.

I spend $20-$30 a week on in game purchases. I contacted them when a $3.99 purchase was charged but never credited to my game. I sent screen shots showing it was not applied & showing it was still locked but they curtly told me it was credited??? I had proof but they would not correct it. They lost a player who spends more than $100 a month over $3.99, great customer service. Plus all my friends are deleting the game too because they see that you can't trust them. Smart business move guys.

This game is more annoying than fun to play. As soon as you load into the game you are bombarded with pop ups and tabs to purchase things. You run out of dice for rolls you are once again bombarded with pop ups. You can earn event items, but can only progress a few stages in events then are forced to buy stages to progress. For a "free to play game" there's a lot of pay walls to actually progress.

Game is entertaining enough, but the pay to play aspect is really in your face. Sometimes you will have to close out 5-6 pop up ads in a row. Side quests that look like you collect in-game items to complete usually require some sort of purchase to get past the second level, no matter how many items you collect. Gameplay is very limited for those of us not willing to spend a lot of money.

Bombarded with give me money, give me money, give me money every time you load the app or run out of rolls. They also added 'rewards' that take up spots on the quest tracks that can only be used after spending money. None of the other slot games do that and it's super frustrating that you can't use your 'rewards' without spending money. The trail has also added extra obstacles (to waste your rolls) to continue making it much harder to progress.

The game is simple but fun enough. Plenty of cute graphics and animations. Major downside is the excessive amount of in-game pop-ups and you should be prepared to close 10+ windows every time the game is opened before you can play anything. After you run out of dice there is an additional 3 or so pop-ups to close every time. It's also the kind of game that pesters you to invite your friends.

This is a game? I'm taken aback by just how little there is to actually DO in this app. Everything just involves you tapping the screen & occasionally choosing which structure you want to "attack". If you're the kind of gamer that can get hours if entertainment from a slot machine that doesn't pay out actual cash, then I guess you'll have fun here? Two stars for the presentation, but this isn't worth the time needed to earn in TesterUp.

Cute game but insane amount of pop ups. I enjoyed the game itself but I had to sift through 25 pop ups this morning before I could even play. Ad after ad trying to get me to make an in game purchase. It's obnoxious and it's why I uninstalled the game. I shouldn't need to spend 5 minutes sifting through that many pop ups before I can even play. Plus you get bombarded with the same pop ups anytime you run out of coins or rolls. It's excessive.

I love playing this, it's a great way to pass the time. You can also get free dice by watching ads so you don't have to pay unless you really want to. That being said I think past a certain level the game stops letting you watch ads for dice. I'm roughly at level 165, and I've stopped receiving those prompts. That or my game is bugged.

The game started out being entertaining, but it has way too much going on. I counted 21 pop-up screens I had to close before I could roll my first turn when I opened the game. The other drawback is that it often leaves you no choice but to attack friends on your social media list. I don't want to set my friends back in their game play! You had a decent idea for a game, but all the extras suck the fun out of it.

Installed this through mistplay to earn points for Google play cards and it's the easiest money I've ever made. This is one of those games that you begin playing and completely fall into, makes an hour feel like 10 mins. Only complaint is, it can be difficult without spending, but def not impossible, just much slower going. I have huge issues with anxiety/panic disorders and this helps distract my brain, which is huge in my little world. All this said, would recommend.

We need teams back... the moral of the game is down I feel. We used to be abke to complete team tasks, why did this end. If purchasing Dice, you would sell more if you charged less. for 5 bucks you should get at least 10,000 dice, not 20 dollars... Bringing trams back and making side games and achievements a little less hard to win or get to... and there has been a lot of glitches where people lose out on things and never get reimbursed. I do like that you brought back the watch video for rolls!

too many glitches and developers changing options on the fly. i always use the 25x multiplier, but it keeps randomly disappearing. options go from 10to 50. support seems to be mostly AI canned responses or try to explain how to select the multiplier. been playing for years, i know how to play. I've confirmed this is happening to others. stop modifying the options and changing them back randomly!

if i could give zero, I would. Screenshot or record your gameplay because if the game glitches, and it will, the game support will argue with you and tell you you are wrong, even with picture proof. They will also just end the help ticket when they want, even if the problem is not resolved. "Helper peon" Claire is the worst of them all. there you go i sent a video of the conversation and what happened. --- waste of time--- rating stays the same. they are full of canned responses.

I really enjoy playing this game with good graphics and storyline. I don't like every time you play the game you have to wait for like 10 different packages to pay for. it would be nice to just start the game and play instead of waiting all those that you have to exit out. I look for games that I can do the same as others w/o having to pay a fortune. I hav nt had income over 2yrs and it's nice to be able to enjoy a game but I have not had the luck of getting a pet when I'm out of dice that's it

The gameplay is mildly entertaining, the controls are simple, but the reason for 1 star, is the amount of attempted packages they try to force down your throat everytime you run out of dice, or log on. I have to wait 2 minutes for all the forced BS to stop popping up before I can even get to the actual game content... absolutely ridiculous!

The game used to be enjoyable but now you can't complete much of anything without paying. Even paying rarely gets you what you need to complete side goals. Reaching out to support is pointless because they want access to the storage or to the camera roll and it tells you to grant permissions. I have all permissions granted and still can't supply support the requested info. I'm uninstalling the game due to these things.

Played this game a lot. It is extremely rigged and, not only that, about half the time if you spend money you will not get everything in the offers and have to contact support which can ruin your run in a game heavily built on timers. If you're going to play this one, don't spend and if you do spend make sure to check that you're getting everything you're supposed to.

ok...I had to revise...NEVER spending a dime on this game again. I actually made it through the "first" 10 levels and was able to "adopt" my pet but its a scam...you can't keep it...and there are several sets of 10 levels. Went through all of that and logged in to see an egg again. Also if you're trying to defeat Chunk know that at the last chest the "hits" impact is decreased significantly.

Purchasers Be Wary. I enjoyed this game, even tho it's a bit repetitive & lacks rewards you really want (unless you pay). Here's my issue...I made a $2.99 purchase, game told me there was an error; I tried again 30 secs later. That went thru, but I was also charged for the 1st! (a $2.99 purchase to use pearls to gain more rewards. No one could have bought twice!). I contacted support and was told no refund even tho game was at fault. Said I rec'd what I pd for. Read reviews! Game steals your $.

Fun until the last week or so. The game loads extremely slow, and never fully finishes loading actually active buttons. I think there's probably too much front end offer pop-ups overloading it. Buttons load and "click" when you tap but nothing happens. Roll button doesn't even click. The number of offer pop-ups has always been overwhelming, especially when you use up the # or rolls you have your bet set to, then you get all the offer pop ups, change the bet level, use them up, same offers popup.

Conned into playing this game through an app that's supposed to earn you cash. This game is terrible. 100% scam. Watch ads and never get the rewards. The game assaults you with pop-up ads trying to sell you stuff from their store. Support tells you you never watched the ad, even though you did. Then they keep blaming you and tell you to restart your phone even though you just restarted it. So you restart it again and watch another ad and still don't get your reward. Don't just walk away. Run.

I LOVE this lil game. It's so cute & it's actually fun. I love the fact that you can buy more dice if you want to, but you dont have to like most games. I love the fact that it doesn't take forever to level up as well. I would def recommend this game to other people. update 7/4/26: I still love the game, but after making a couple purchases everything becomes SO expensive! I can't afford to pay $50+ for the packages. Please make the prices more reasonable in the higher levels!!

In the last month or so my opinion of this game has gone down. I don't like being forced into the jet pack duel things. I don't play to win big or be number 1. I play because I thought it was a cute game and it was fun, at first. But again, with the tournament, it shows and updates your number in real time, with a noise and a great big arrow. Makes it too competitive, more stressful, and less enjoyable. Given that I've spent actual money on this game I'd hate to quit but if this keeps up I will.

I mostly like this game, but it tries entirely too hard to force players to buy stuff, with easily a dozen pop up ads for paid content before you are allowed to actually play. This happens EVERY TIME one opens the game. Only about one or two of them will ever have any relevance to the gameplay. Seriously, just consolidate all the paid content to one button, STFU, and let players play in peace.

glitchy and laggy when you first open the app but catches up after a couple minutes once the micro transaction suggestions and stuff loads in. the game is surprisingly oddly satisfying with the animations and graphics. I do find it annoying how often it throws them up on the screen once your rolls are lower and almost empty. I also don't see any benefits to being part of a team in this game. otherwise its better than I expected

I've been playing for years I have several pets and am far in the game, I have to close and reopen the game at least twice! It's like the buttons are heavy, like the game was designed to move slow and the longer you play the worse it gets! The game lags and freezes A LOT! I have even gone in the settings and changed it to performance over graphics - no difference! Some of these challenges are timed! Slow to load and the annoying pop-up's! Also lvl 10 for a pet now is greedy! It is not my phone!

the game itself is fun! cute graphics, lots of things to keep you entertained. however, the practice of locking users out of watching ads to get items once they make a purchase is shameful. and gaslighting users by saying it doesn't happen is unethical. I thought my game was messed up but upon looking around it seems common knowledge that making a purchase, no matter how small, removes ad rewards to force your hand into spending more money. very not cool.

Too difficult and unrealistic now. with the new updates, it makes it almost impossible to move forward or achieve goals without purchasing more dice. changing the trails to 15 cases instead of 10, or the amount of steps you must take to get to each chest.. both unrealistic to achieve now. you literally cannot make any progress in this game unless you spend money.. and this is embarrassing to say but I know I've spent over $400-500 on this game over the last year. Need to go back & make easier.

I've been playing Dice Dreams for a while now, and it's become one of my favorite mobile games. The graphics are colorful and fun, the gameplay is easy to learn, and there's always something to do. I enjoy building my kingdom, collecting cards, and competing with friends. The game keeps me coming back with daily rewards, events, and challenges that make it exciting without being overly complicated. One thing I especially like is that you can make progress even with short play sessions.

Game cheats. I've been playing this game for a year or 2 now and I can't complete any challenge without spending money. Also, when I bring problems to their attention I never get the problem fixed before the time runs out on challenges. I've spent a couple of hundred dollars I'm sure. They have tried by giving little incentives for things that mess up, but it never equals what I loss due to a glitch. I'm finally done with them.

I love this game. The addiction is real. only issue i have is how once you start making purchases, the prices get really high for low quality prizes. And how when you get far in, you can't win any missions without spending. Really other than the prizes not matching the price like making an expensive purchase just to keep getting stickers that you already have over and over. So that purchase was just like giving yall free money with nothing in return sometimes. Can't get enough of this game tho

This game forced your hand to buy rolls. I was playing and getting a lot of ads and in turn getting free rolls but then I made a small purchase not intending to buy anymore and suddenly my ads disappeared and it's impossible to make any sort of progress as it takes 8 hours just to get a full refill in turn forcing you to buy rolls just to actually play the game.

to be quite honest, I have been playing this game for months and it's REALLY fun. the best thing is no ads. everyday is something new to discover. everything in there is fun, and there are always other stuff to accomplish rather than just completing kingdoms. the only things that are sort of negative-ish are these: 1. some of the things in there are like p2w things, and if you want a lot of stuff offhand you have to pay money, and sometimes its not very cheap. 2. lag occurs very often.

ive played this game for a while now and im uninstalling. Ive spent a lot of money because you get to a point where you need one single item to win a large prize and you never get it but then, of course, right before the time is up on this side game that one item you need becomes available to buy in a package. On the side trail game. I got 9 of 10 chests and used 100,000 spins AFTER the 9th chest and only got 1/4 of the way to the 10th. Thats crazy! You can't win!

The colors are pretty, but the ads are ridiculous. The deals are not very good either. The ads are also deceptive. They make you believe that you will get one thing, but they will not give it to you. Pets, for instance, they advertise that if you buy you will keep your pet but it is not true. The last level for keeping your pet is ridiculously hard and even with a hundred dollar purchase you cannot keep your pet. It also runs slower compared to the ios version. Not laggy, just slower.

I wish the developers would make some of the game board builds were slightly animated when they are touched, after a build is completed - such as a peon using 1 or 2 of them. Also ,I wish they would make the peons a little more interactive and animated when they are touched and it would be nice to "earn some rewards (like dice or coins) for interacting with the some of the peons a (certain) number of times".

I've been given the run around for 7 days regarding a glitch/error that occurred on an event. I've been BEYOND patient, trying to let them correct the mistake but they are adamant there wasn't one. I've spent nearly $200 in this game and they'd rather give me ai generated responses than fix a simple problem. Careful spending your money in this game, if something happens, they do not care edit to respond- I have had an active ticket open this whole time. We are in contact, you don't care

Dice dreams is a very fun game with lots of side 'games' to play without being too much, like some games. I really enjoy playing but I do wish that as you progress past about level 75 it didn't become impossible to actually finish or win anything without spending actual money. That is really frustrating because I feel like I'll be giving it up soon because it's starting to just make me kinda sad/frustrated when I play. I'm on level 153 and don't want to spend my money just to complete 1 thing.

TOTALLY ADDICTIVE! I absolutely love this game! *EDIT* - After getting so far into the game it becomes very "buggy." I have had repeated issues with not getting things I paid for and also having popups on my screen that I can't click off of. The game is fun however once you get so far unless you spend money you are not able to continue. When you contact support if you are in the US be prepared to wait 24 to 72 hours for an answer and sometimes longer for the issue to be resolved.

fun but annoying. its a good way to pass the time, plus it's unique and entertaining. to progress or keep bonuses, you'll have to pay actual money. it's very difficult otherwise. also the spins have such a poor rate once you get close to finishing on certain events, that it just feels rigged. i understand games have to bring in some profit, but i am tired of paying just to progress.

Too much going on at once. there are so many pop-ups when the game starts to open at least 15 of them the early on the game freezes and shuts down. I have to restart the game sometimes losing gameplay, only to have to deal with all the pop-up ads and all of those icons having to reload. there's too much going on in the game. try this game on two different tablets in the same problem freezes and shuts down.

Enjoy the game itself but it is slow sometimes when rewarding certain things. It takes forever and causes the game to stall. Most importantly, I have had to contact Support on separate occasions for double charging me when it does not give you the items the first time, says the purchase did not complete but you try the transaction again and it gives you the items but hits you with double charges!

Time consuming but can move up levels easily. The game gives U free things (ie. coins, dice rolls, etc...) & a daily gift. I wish I could complete an animal before they change 2 a new one. U have 2 play daily 2 get shields 2 protect your buildings from getting blown up. Can't change the background. I don't like attacking & stealing from other players. It's hard not 2 get the blow up dice that stops U from "Steal" ing.

This game is a huge money grab/pay to win. If you dont want to spend money, dont expect to get very far. If you are okay with spending money on a mobile game, they utilize what they call "dynamic pricing" to continue to raise all prices. The same items will vary greatly day to day and player to player. Absolutely a scam game. DO NOT PLAY.

Update 5/15/26 to my original review: I have noticed that the higher you get in kingdoms the harder it is to complete cookies and trails. On the last chest in trails the bar hardly moves at all. I have had over 70000 moves and it doesn't go anywhere. I also think you should give more cookie rewards versus some of the other stuff. This would allow you to gain pets without having to spend boo coo amounts of money just to get cookies. Great game to pass time but is very addictive.

Now, as I've been playing this game foe 6 months, my view has changed. This game builds your desire to play. Co.pletely addictive. However, it eventually has you spending a lot of money to get ahead. I spent over $100 in 1 week, and it did absolutely nothing for me. It used to let you watch ads to earn rolls and stuff, not it just takes all of your money to ha e you spending more money. DONT DOWNLOAD OR PLAY. Then support ignores everything you say!

I love the game and honestly play about 3 hours a day, if not more, but I really hate that so many of the quests or side activities require you to spend actual money to complete them and there is literally no way around it. I also don't like that you get a pop up every single time you run out of coins or spins to invite people. If I dont get harassed to invite people at least 50 times while playing, it doesn't happen once.

Not engaging enough. I downloaded this game to earn tokens for another app. It reminds me of the Coin Master game but somehow it feels less. The big reward goals are unrealistic unless you pay to play as they do not give you enough energy/dice rolls to get the momentum going. After a week maybe closer to two weeks, I am only at level/kingdom 8, which is the first big reward goal that you were supposed to complete in one day :O. Going to keep playing in case I just need to hit a certain level.

Good,clean, well made, great graphics, fun game. No ads! Keeps your attention. Limited in app spending. Good choice. Update after 1 week of playing. The only drawback is when you are out of rolls the game pops up with 3 offers consistently n persistently unless you find a way around the game by playing other parts of it to keep it going to generate free rolls without buying more Dice. Important to use your Google points turned into coupons for this game!!! Be sure to screenshoot your purchases!

Very fun game just takes a lot of coins to play to level up. So if you want to level up you have to keep buying their package deals.In addition, it would be helpful to get the hackers from taking over the tournaments. There is no way to have 47,000 in the tournament when I play for hours and only have a few thousand try to make the game more fair for those of us who are paying to play thank you very much love the game.

i absolutely love this game and have tried multiple times and ways to add friends that I know that play... I cannot add people right now. That's my frustration and it seems to really lag and go slow lately, not sure if it's my phone or the game. I can spend hours playing, no ads no forced buys. fun and mindless entertainment! but help with the friends add please!

This game is nice. If I don't have time or mood to play for a few, there's no punishment or guilt. The specials like Attack, Steal and coin bonuses level up easily. There are plenty of rewards for watching ads but very few mandatory if you just want to keep going. It's not challenging but that's what RPG's and puzzle games are for. Enjoy

it was fabulous until I did the update... I have more problems with this game now than I care to discuss. it takes at least 30 minutes of replaying everything, because it goes so slow and freezes. then you have to start all over again. once you get going tho it's absolutely the best! one of my faves!!!!!!! Just don't do any updates, and you will have a blast

It is a fun game, some of the tasks are nearly impossible unless you purchase something. Even then it is impossible. I love teamwork, but the one challenge they provide with trimming hedges is impossible without multiple purchases as enough scissors is never provided without spending a hundred dollars.I even spent 84.99 once and still did not get enough to help my 4 partners finish task. If you just play it is a fun game overall.The animations are hilarious and I do like game.

This game is one of the few games that is fun and doesn't have a bunch of ads unless you want optional items. So nice to play without an ad popping up every 15 seconds. The graphics are cute and I have had no problem leveling up. Especially if I just play once a day, they seem to reward you when you stay away for a minute. Thanks for making a fun game that doesn't bombard the player with ads.

I spend so much to play and it takes thousands of cookies or rolls to win things and they put things in like stickers that dont count for anything as winnings or barely any coins after making you spend so much to get to that. At least allow you to win something meaningful for each stage when you are having to spend so much to play the game it is sad. I see people complaining about 3.99 purchases I dont get offered anything less than a 20$ purchase! sometimes 100$ packages i have spent 1000s

I've been playing this game on and off for YEARS! I don't know what's been going on the past maybe 6 months or so but this game ALWAYS freezes, knocks me off of it and then I gotta start again, normally whenever it knocks me off it's because I'm trying to watch a video to get dice and then I'll be done watching the video, click on the x and it takes me out of the WHOLE game and then I dont ever get the dice I just sat and watched the ad for. Y'all need to do better!

I really was enjoying this game. it was one that you could play and advance through without having to spend really money because of the many opportunities to watch adds to receive extra rolls and other resources. however, I spent a small.amount and now all the ads to get extra rolls are gone. its like I spent money once and they decided to try to force me to spend more by getting rid of the free opportunities. As someone who has a fixed income and is disabled, this sucks.

The popups constantly in my face before I start doing anything or after I finish anything are really annoying. Also the further I get I. the game the more the game keeps crashing at random. I want to love this app since I understand the gameplay so well and love all the lil side events but I think when I finish earning I'm gonna have to uninstall. Just doesn't work well enough justify fighting through all those popups as leisure time.

I love this game so much fun! However for about the past year I have been having a lot of issues with glitches and in general the game not working right! I truly hope this can be fixed soon I've played this game for years but am about to stop if it keeps cheating me every time I get a "fight" roll cause it seems to freeze every time 😬😭

The games decent but it will randomly give you massive luck boosts after paying one time than just absolutely screw you over when you dont. pop ups everywhere and a review from a year ago said you used to be able to watch ads to get rolls, which would be nice, but as far as im aware was removed for the more direct approach of asking for your money

BEWARE: IF YOUR PAYMENT FAILS, THEY WILL LEGITIMATELY STEAL YOUR MONEY (even when you provide your payment history and transaction ID). It's based on a pay to win scheme that does not even rightfully give rewards. It's fun and addictive but most certainly at a price, but a price that not only skews the reward function but may ignore it entirely.

I love this game so much. I think it's because of the sound effects tbh. However, I think it's a great game to play especially if you only play here and there. However, I am not a fan of how many times ads pop up to "purchase this deal" or "join this" after you don't have a certain amount of dice. It does get annoying after some time.

I used to love this game until it got to the point that I can't make progress without buying stuff and then the daily goals then get impossible to complete without spending even more money. And now forced duels have been added that are not only annoying but almost always impossible to win without using up your dice.

I would give this game a 5 star but it's very annoying that my game freezes every time I enter a fight. It's unfair that I am a play to win player and roll High multipliers above 50 and l get absolutely nothing in return whenever this happens! I have cleared the cache uninstalled and reinstalled, the whole nine yards and it still does the same thing. Super play needs to fix this because I'm just about ready to uninstall this game

REASON FOR MY NEW GAME REVIEW & LOW SCORE: I have been playing Dice Dreams a VERY LONG TIME!I MY ISSUE IS: After about 6 months the game took longer & longer to load and would lag more & more. WELL, it has gotten to the point it is taking more than 40 minutes to load and then it lags so bad I COMPLETELY LOSE INTEREST IN PLAYING PERIOD!!! This is HIGHLY UPSETTING because Dice Dreams is one of my ALL TIME FAVORITE GAMES TO PLAY, AND 1 OF 2 I CLAIM ON MY GOOGLE PLAY WEEKLY! PLEASE FIX IT!!!

Right off the bat, it's very generous with the amount of dice and coins you get. Most games will put ridiculously tight limits on how much of everything you get so you're forced to buy things pretty quickly, but this is enjoyable even if you can't afford in-game purchases. It's fun and engaging, and doesn't come across as just a greedy cash grab. I normally don't play these types of games because they bore me, but this one is good.

Respectfully, I don't see the point in this game other than getting you to spend money. The second you run out of dice you're jumped by 3 different popups showing "if you pay you can get more dice!". Only playing because I'm getting money on a 3rd party app. The begging and microtransaction jumpscares made me go out of my way to write this review to say that this game is not worth your time. 2 stars because there's no AI art involved and (I hope) real artists created the assets.

this game is a lot of fun until you start spending money they up the prices based on what they think you will pay. Different players have different prices. Customer service is not the best. It's really just a money grabbing game I do not recommend. While the graphics are cute the game is rigged and some of the events are just not even real players.

I would give it 5 stars, but the game seems to only be beneficial after making an in-app purchase. I'm not opposed to spending the money, but I can't spend hundreds of dollars a week just to advance. Maybe a one time purchase to play with upgrades offered to purchase...? I know it's a business, but it is an expensive game if you want to progress.

The game isn't bad... don't expect to play for long though w/o being willing to pay or else barely being able to play. The graphics begging for money everytime you open the game is like a Temu experience, it literally throws pop upside at you back to back, today I was just over it. Also, record while ur play'n. I got cheated out of 25,000 dice rolls & cs never helped me, gave a generic FAQs copy & paste response that had nothing to do w/ the issue. Like it, but Done Play'n.

Simple play, numb brained fun. Kashkick accomplishments are pretty unreachable without spending money to reach them. If you have the money, buy the packages to meet the goals and you will get paid back though. I have made a few goals without spending money, but the big amounts are not reachable without spending money up front. The game is still fun though and the side game goals are fun too. The game is a pretty good time filler and that's mostly why I play anyways. Load times are quick also.

Lots of opportunities to score if you are willing to pay. The earliest levels allow you to get more dice rolls by watching ads. Later in the game, you can get a handful of free rolls each hour but the ability to top off with ads is gone and all the achievements cost exponentially more do that to really make any progress.

they steal from us and reply back days later when what you purchased for a event is irrelevant because the event ended. It affects you bad. I made 15 purchases they were never given to me with everything. I got purchase order and emails to prove it. when they do that we spend 2 times as much trying to play the game. Straight thieves, don't waste your money

I have been playing this game for almost three years now everyday and you guys took away the option to watch an ad for either more spins in regular game and special challenge game! Why do you want to charge money for this now? I enjoy this game but now that you took this away I will not play anymore and uninstall this game and save what little space I have left for a new game that isn't money hungry!!!

This game freezes on me many times a day. Will not roll dice except on auto roll. Can't build because it's frozen & everyone steals your money to build!! Prevents you from moving up to the next level & Uninstalling & reinstalling doesn't work on this game OR Domino Dreams! So, I'm getting ripped off by Free Cash & can't move up in levels to make money! This is total BS!!!😡😡😡

Okay to play, dont make in app purchases. I bought a pack for $6, was supposed to be event cookies and dice. Alerted Customer Support that I didnt receive the dice, they kept closing out the concern without actually looking into it. You have to purchase in this game or you can't level up or complete missions and albums. The higher level the more expensive it is. Minimum of 20,000 to complete a trail. They've ruined the game with greed! Kingdoms go from hundreds of millions to billions to complete. Game is more stress than fun.

The game itself is fine, but massively ruined by how they keep popping up screens to buy things with real money and put the "buy" button EXACTLY where the dice roll button is. As such you're constantly clicking a button to spend real money and could easily be tricked into spending something you don't want to. Edited review! I came 1st in a tournament and won 1,500 dice. I used 900 and the game crashed. I logged back in and ALL my dice were gone! Now I can't sign in to the game at all. Disappointed and Frustrated – The More You Spend, the Worse It Gets I’ve been playing Dice Dreams for a while now and, honestly, it could be a fun and enjoyable game – but there's one major issue that ruins the whole experience. I’ve spent a significant amount of money on this game, expecting at least some reasonable return in terms of luck or progress. Instead, I’ve noticed the complete opposite: the more I spend, the worse my luck gets, especially with dice rolls. It's incredibly frustrating

This app is just a money farm.Every time you start the game, you have to click through 15-30 animated popups. This is not an exaggeration. I have counted. If you run out of rolls, you have to go through them again. So if you run out, but gain more rolls, a single game often involve clicking away 40-100 popups. The game's animations will run out your timer on bonuses, which can get frustrating. It brings you close to the main prize, but then you have to pay to have enough to get the prize.

Fun, addictive game, it has issues though. It's glitchy, half the time you don't receive your tournament prizes and support basically say you're lying. The pricing is totally unfair. The more you spend the more they charge. The more dice you have, the harder they make winning the events. "Gifts" on Instagram/Facebook don't work most of the time (just get a message saying either it's expired or already claimed) I even won a sticker pack and it didn't work. Overall, just a money grab.

It's a cute game, but I'm so sick of the obnoxious pop-ups to promote paid products. I get that it's a free to play game, but I'm on level 29 and it says a lot that I now spend more time clicking through these adds than I do playing through my full 60 rolls. When you first load in: 5-7 pop ups. When you run out of rolls: 5-7 pop ups. I much prefer Monopoly GO, it has far fewer pop ups and the game generally feels more fun to play through my full amount of dice.

Very fun to start with, and if you make purchases there are a lot of extra rewards, so those definitely make it more fun temporarily. But it takes 10 hours to get 50 dice rolls, so without paying it's hardly worth coming on. Have rolled 170+ and gotten a couple of million, it takes over 60 to complete a build, and if uncompleted you get attacked by other players! Best part is the Rock Paper Scissors fights, but those are very rare and automatically over before you noticed if it was on auto roll.

Ok, so I only get 15 mins for a coffee break at work. Once I've got through the immense amounts of "pop ups" trying to get me to buy packs or invite friends or do everything else it's time to go back to work..... maybe put packs where I can look when I want rather than forcing them in my face. Other than that small annoyance, the games quite fun, simple and easy to play.

At first glance, this game seems like fun. But soon you realize how many things they purposefully lie about or skirt around. You can add friends, but it almost never works. Gifting doesn't work. At a certain point, the pay wall to get past a kingdom is ridiculous. The fun dies quickly.

I paid for an in-game item but didn't receive the item. First of all, pop ups are annoying. Get it when you start up and you get them, but everytime dice go to low? Been trying to contact support for 3 days :(. I wasn't rewarded for the puzzle I finished so I was unable to move on to the last one to finish the event. This game is absolute fraud. I spent a really good amount of money , but I don't get what I am meant to get. STOP WITH THE ADDS! 7 adds that I have to close every single time I open the app, run out of dice, or open a side quest. Only been playing a couple of days, had a payout already. Haven't had any problems so far, but time will tell. Very addictive game, I really enjoy playing it, just to see what comes next. Not as rewarding! 10 pop-ups before I start playing, trying to get me to spend cash. 5 -8 pop-ups every time I run out of dice trying to get me to spend cash. I spend more time clearing pop-ups than actually playing. I'm enjoying this but the amount of pop ups I get when I run out of dice rolls. I really don't need to have 5/6 pop ups every single time. It's too much. its not ads that annoy me. it's a fun game but at times it kicks you off in the middle of plane or it kicks you off in the middle of purchasing something on it

This game is super fun, and I play it pretty much daily. The graphics are decent, the game is relaxing and engaging, and there are rotating mini games and contests which make it more fun. The game is cute and can be entertaining but I bought 2 times small in-game packages and they took 10+ mins to arrive on my account. This is terrible! There are few times I placed top 3 on the tournament yet did not get the promising gift such as the dices, special items such as cards and coins(to be used in the game). The game is actually getting annoying ,not giving you points ,enough coins, or spin and credit to rise you animal finish the task .we have to shop to get somewhere in this game,and very expensive! Fun little game with mini games in between. Graphics are awesome. This game was ok in the beginning, but if you play often you notice you run out dice quickly and to get more it cost $40 for a pack that doesn't last long and can't even get what I wanted. one time I had 80000 after spending $80 and I still couldn't get it. Not gonna lie, I love this wee game. It's quite addictive. There are plenty of opportunities to earn rolls most days and there are constant extra events. Edit... The game has become a bit glitchy. Too many ads, it gets to the point in the game where it cycles through the same 5 adds to get you to pay to play and doesn't let you play anymore. was actually enjoying it until the recent update. game crashes after 30 seconds of use, uninstalled, reinstalled, cleared cache, lowered graphic settings. still crashes. according to some people I know who play as well it's happened to them too since the update, which is a shame because I want to rate the game higher, but for nearly 3GB worth of storage for an app burning memory unless its fixed it's a 1 star.
